Three rules

  1. One card answers another, to its right. Events flow to the right only. A Pulse is heard by the next card to its right that waits for a Pulse; Spark gains and Overfill are heard by every card to the right that waits for them.
  2. Only a Timer closes a circle. A Timer sends its event back to the first Slot. A Chain with no Timer runs once and its plate reads "Runs once. Add a Timer to keep it turning."
  3. An engine stops when a card cannot do its job. Meter full, no Collector charge, nothing in reach. No turn limit; the meter stays capped at 100.
